title: Record cost and inference events for every harness run
narrative: Finance asks Nubble whether a harness run actually burned billable units. He runs a short one-shot job and checks the event log. He needs both an inference event and a cost event with non-zero units — the same signals he would forward to billing or a Grafana panel. If those events are missing, operations is flying blind. If they are present, he trusts the ledger enough to alert on it.
implementation: Harness runs emit structured events on `EventLog`: inference completion and cost accounting via `CostAccountant` / `InMemoryCostAccountant` producing `core:cost` (and `core:inference`) with ability-scaled units. `PassThroughHarness` (and other families) sit on the same path so every run records ledger signals without a separate billing bolt-on. Event types are host-extendable under the `core:` namespace in `mechaharness.core.events`.
validation: Story kind `pass_through` → `_run_pass_through`. In-process uses `ScriptedInference` + `PassThroughHarness` + `InMemoryEventLog`; `openai_compat` twins replay cassette HTTP through `OpenAICompatStrategy`. Soft expects: `core:inference` and `core:cost` present with non-zero units. Related: `tests/test_events.py`, `tests/test_harness.py`, `tests/test_pass_through.py`.
